title: Training Questions and Answers: Relief on Gas Catch-Up After a Run of Estimated Reads
content:
# Relief on Gas Catch-Up After Estimated Reads — Utility Services Program

**The rule.** On a Utility Services Program gas true-up line, the capped gas catch-up is counted according to the estimate run and the resident's tenure:

- when the estimated gas reads in the window number **at least 2** and the Apartment Home Lease's move-in date lies **at least 24 whole months** before the billing date, the capped gas catch-up is **halved and rounded down to a whole therm**;
- when the estimated gas reads number **at least 2** and the move-in date lies **fewer than 24 whole months** before the billing date, the capped gas catch-up is **multiplied by 0.75 and rounded up to a whole therm**;
- in every other situation the capped gas catch-up is **counted as measured**.

The window is the estimated gas reads dated fewer than three whole months before the billing date. The figure 2 is the maximum number of consecutive estimated reads on every program that bills gas. The catch-up therms billed on the line are the counted catch-up.

## Questions answered

**Which estimated reads are counted?** The estimated gas reads on the account dated fewer than three whole months before the billing date.

**Whose move-in date?** The move-in date recorded on the Apartment Home Lease the account serves.

**How is "24 whole months" read?** Whole calendar months from the move-in date to the billing date. A lease with a move-in date of 2024-03-15 has 24 whole months on a billing date of 2026-03-15, and 23 on 2026-03-14.

**What if only one estimated gas read is in the window?** Then neither of the first two conditions holds and the capped gas catch-up is counted as measured.

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

| Estimated gas reads in window | Whole months since move-in | Capped gas catch-up | Counted catch-up |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 30 | 26.000 | 13 (half of 26.000) |
| 2 | 30 | 25.500 | 12 (half is 12.75, rounded down) |
| 2 | 10 | 25.500 | 20 (0.75 times 25.500 is 19.125, rounded up) |
| 1 | 30 | 25.500 | 25.500 (as measured) |
